body:
Records the owner's decision of 2026-11-21: the merged zero-setup watcher (PR 707) is the design and none of the orchestrator design of issue 655 is adopted. Adds requirement row R38 (start rule, cron scheduler, one standing coordinator per project, a person's go for every push and merge) and the comparison file with its evidence. Docs only, no code changes. Issue 655 was closed as not planned; its not-covered features are tracked in issues 716, 717 and 718.
